=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:29-30 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root and template `audit-plans.md` files differ, so the byte-for-byte `test_template_parity` assertion fails and the required CI job fails.
  WHY: The root file retains in-session phrasing while the template has Claude-engine orchestrator wording; this is confirmed by the reported `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failure.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-272 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The redirect parser removes a numeric token before `>` even when it is a space-separated push refspec such as `2`.
  WHY: For `git push origin 2 > /tmp/out`, it drops the intended refspec and checks the current branch instead, allowing a push to a merged-PR branch to bypass the guard.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:255-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root hook copy lacks parser changes present in the template copy, leaving the copies divergent.
  WHY: The byte-identity test fails while they differ; applying the template changes also makes the redirect-parsing defect above live.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:318-334 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the `|| exit` handling present in the template when tracking conditional `cd` segments.
  WHY: It can attribute a git invocation to a directory the shell never entered, causing false-positive or false-negative merge-status checks.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:318-321 (per LAST RUN DIFF) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `|| exit` check can skip a legitimate git invocation after a successful `cd`.
  WHY: The check can discard the guarded push from the parsed targets, leaving no merged-PR check for that push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339-348 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root env-assignment regex does not accept `+=` when recognizing `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE` modifiers.
  WHY: A command using such an assignment can run in a different repository than the guard assumes, so the merge-status check targets the wrong repository.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339-348 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new handling clears the tracked working directory for `GIT_WORK_TREE+=` without checking whether the appended value is resolvable.
  WHY: A subsequent git invocation can fall back to the catch-all `HEAD` warning instead of receiving an exact branch check.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:432-438 and 451 (_push_targets) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` does not account for a remote already supplied through `--repo`/`--rep` and does not recognize the cited abbreviated option forms.
  WHY: It can treat the first refspec as a remote and omit it from the guard check, causing the guard to check the wrong branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:466-467 (_push_targets) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not resolve a `HEAD` push refspec to the checked-out branch name.
  WHY: It queries merge status for a branch literally named `HEAD`, potentially allowing a push whose actual target branch has a merged PR.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1282-1290 (_evaluate_bash) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_evaluate_bash` does not pin a symbolic target tip to the resolved SHA returned by `git rev-parse`.
  WHY: A push between the PR query and merge-base check can change what the symbolic name resolves to, so the ancestry check may not use the commit matched by the PR query.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1282-1290 (_evaluate_bash) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If `git rev-parse` times out, the fallback creates a target with `reaches_remote=True` and triggers the full API-based check path.
  WHY: The fallback can block unnecessarily when no push was in progress, although it fails closed.
- docs/plans/semble-overflow-off-lazy-bootstrap-plan.md:640-652 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The plan sets `SEMBLE_STATIC_CONTEXT_FILE` for judge prefetch without ensuring `${RUNTIME_DIR}/judge_static.txt` exists and is readable before the query.
  WHY: The prefetch can run before `assemble_judge_static_context` creates the file, causing the readable-file check to fail and `static_dup_bytes` telemetry to be omitted.
- docs/plans/semble-overflow-off-lazy-bootstrap-plan.md:508-511 and 521-523 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The plan requires `semble_ensure_ready` to emit a fallback event with `target=<slug>` but calls it without arguments and does not define a target parameter or default.
  WHY: The event can have an empty or missing `target` field, causing telemetry validation to reject it.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  WHY: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1000` requires byte-identical copies; additionally, a redirected push can be parsed with the wrong refspec tokens and make the guard check the wrong branch.

  WHY: The guard could attribute a git invocation to a directory the shell never entered, causing false-positive or false-negative merge-status checks.

  severity=high | confidence=[5]

  WHY: A `GIT_DIR+=default/subdir git push` command can make the guard assume a different working directory than git uses.

  WHY: A push between the PR API query and merge-base check can make the symbolic ref resolve to a different commit.

  WHY: A transient `git rev-parse` failure can cause an unnecessary fail-closed block even when no push was in progress.
